family_scope: Shared multi-domain router vs per-domain routers

recovered_spec.primary_design: ONE shared router with task/domain conditioning allowed
recovered_spec.reason: preserve the shared multi-domain system contribution

critical_finding: The frozen Phase24 ablation-plan table defines NO shared-vs-domain-specific-router ablation ID. Per-domain routers are FORBIDDEN in the primary design and are recorded only as a 'later controlled ablation', WITHOUT a frozen ID. It is therefore NOT part of the frozen Phase28 matrix and may NOT be introduced opportunistically (see §22).
related_frozen_id: R2 (router without task_id) probes WHETHER conditioning matters, but it is NOT the same as separate per-domain routing and must not be reported as such.
